$comment: Blind rater card. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md §1-3, eval/SCORECARD.template.json (and eval/presets.json for the idle-roguelike weights, eval/score.sh to run it). No PLAN.md, research/, CUT docs, other cards or source opened. Also skimmed tools/driver.mjs header (the brief points to it). Notes: scratchpad/raterZ/notes.md; shots: scratchpad/raterZ/shots/.
evaluator: raterZ (seed 1102, headed GPU phone 400x800 @3x, production build :5230)

absences: simulated overnight via ?dev=1&absent=8h (16 offline runs, 'rested 320m'); not a real wall-clock absence

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: My fourth heir kept coming home around D6-D8 until the overnight report said 'PLATEAU — R3 return ended 13 runs, none past D8', and the next run showed why: a shielded Goblin Warlord on D8 that sent him back at 7/42. I spent the gold I'd been hoarding on the boss-focus card, the forecast for D9 went from 0% to 22%, and I deleted my own useless 'foe: heavy → retreat' row which pushed it to 40%. The next heir hit 'WARLORD BREAKS', split a pink jelly on D9, took an axe from a cage, reached the Fens on D10 and banked $218 — my rule set's first run past the boss.

probes.clarity: Did you ever not know what just happened? Twice: the forecast said 'D9 0%' for every rule set with no reason until I met the Warlord, and 'drink ✗ no item' fired while that run's FOUND list showed 'heal potion ×4'.
probes.decisions: Name a choice: I kept the bank row at D8 against a 76% death forecast (~$48) and it came home at 7/38 with $148 ('R1 drink heal saved him.'); I'd make that call again.
probes.mastery: What can I do now: I learned that 'return' has to sit below 'drink heal' (moving it took the forecast from bank 8% / ~$69 to 23% / ~$86) and that a boss wall reads as a flat 0% on the shaft.
probes.tension: Where I sweated: run 6 at 7/38 on D7 after 'pops! it swells −3 hp burst', with $148 carried, 'keeps' shown in green and 'death: lose all' on the first run.
probes.feel: What I saw: big pixel callouts 'R4 ATTACK GOBLIN' and 'WARLORD BREAKS' over the map; when two callouts stacked ('R4 HIT RANGED' / 'ARCHER DRAWS') and a jackal overlapped the hero's sprite it was hard to read. Audio unassessed (I could not hear it).
probes.surprise: What surprised me: a monkey stole the sword I had just caged ('The monkey stole the sword.'), bloats on D6 popping for most of my HP, and a Warlord with 'shields up' where the forecast had just said 0%.
probes.expression: My build to a friend: a greedy fighter who drinks heal at 30%, turns for home at 20%, backs into corridors when two things are adjacent, and banks only past the boss; the game tagged my drink-unknown row 'gambler'.
probes.story: One run: 'Zeleth the goblin archer is avenged.' fired on the run right after Zeleth killed my first heir, just after the rule I wrote because of that death fired ('R3 · attack ranged'), and the hero walked past his predecessor's bones on D4.
probes.pacing: Runs were 30 s to 3.5 min at 1x; the camp → send → report loop is quick, but every cage sat on 'choose one' for about 30 s when I didn't tap, and at first runs were over (50 s) before I could read them.
probes.failure: Why I lost: 'goblin · D5 · GAP' with 'R1 drink heal no item ← R1 drank heal at 8/40 hp' and the morgue's 'slain by goblin · blow 3 · 3 hp short' — my fault, I had deleted the return row.
probes.social: No other people or developing relationship; heirs are numbered (♟4) and dead foes get named ('Ashim the goblin').
probes.autonomy: I chose to push for the frontier rather than money, with the bank depth set at 5, 6, 8, then 10; nothing asked me to.
probes.progression: Within run: floors, XP (fighter L1→L4), cage picks; between runs: marks bought +1 row ×2, cards (thief guard, kite archers, gas step, boss focus), auto: restock, auto: keep weapon+armour, path: bones, vault slots, heirs with trait/class picks; but $2016 piled up with nothing to spend it on for most of the session.
probes.aesthetic: The camp is a painted banner over stone rule tablets and the death screen is a torn red banner with a wax seal saying 'GAP'; the dungeon is chunky brown pixel tiles that looked the same from D1 to D8 until the Fens on D10.
probes.return: I came back to '16 runs · 13 returned · 3 banked · 0 deaths · +$957 home', 'PLATEAU — R3 return ended 13 runs, none past D8', and 'R2 fired 0 of 16 runs: hp < 50% → drink unknown'; I deleted R2 and bought the boss card because of it, and I wouldn't rather have stayed.
probes.attribution: The last run ended at D10 because I bought boss focus and moved my bank row to 10; the death before that was mine ('I deleted the return row'); I say 'my rule' about R3/R5 and 'the card' about the bundles I bought.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: The shaft ('bank 81% · return 0% · death 19% · ~$44') made the default rules' 'death 100%' obvious after one death, but 'D9 0%' had no stated cause until I met the Warlord, 'drink ✗ no item' contradicted 'FOUND heal potion ×4', and tapping the gem APPLY sent the next heir straight away.

Bank depth was a real trade-off each check-in (D5 '48% ~$50' vs D4 '88% ~$49'; D8 '24% / death 76%'); lapse: most cards and my own rows read 'reach ~0' on the shaft, so many buys were indistinguishable, and gold had no use until the boss card.
I got better (D4 death → D8 bank → D10 bank; learned rule order: return below drink heal took bank 8%→23%), but most of what I learned was 'buy the card named after what killed me'.
Chosen stakes were legible ('$148 · keeps $148 · bank at D8' at 7/38 hp), yet once the return row was in, 13 of 16 offline runs just came home at 60% and deaths stopped, so the risk flattened.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Callouts land on the beat ('R4 ATTACK GOBLIN', 'WARLORD BREAKS') and the watch ran smoothly headed; lapse: sprites overlap and stacked callouts ('R4 HIT RANGED' over 'ARCHER DRAWS') hid the fight. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Thieves ('The monkey stole the sword.'), bloats ('pops! it swells'), the shielded Warlord and a splitting jelly each changed my rules, but D1-D7 repeated the same jackal/goblin/archer/monkey mix every run.
My set had player rows (return at 20%, adj ≥ 2 → to corridor, bank at 10) and a 'gambler' tag, but by the end four of nine rows were bought cards, which a friend buying the same cards would share.

'Zeleth the goblin archer is avenged.' after my first heir's death, finding heir 2's bones, 'R1 drink heal saved him.', 'WARLORD BREAKS' then 'D10: the Fens'; lapse: most reel lines are floor names and 'Banked $N.'

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 30 s–3.5 min runs, events every 1–3 s, but a cage idles ~30 s on 'choose one'; admin: camp edits are quick but the unlock list is 30+ entries, and the first run (50 s) ended before I could follow it.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Every death named the fight, the gap and each rule's status ('R5 to corridor no path ← foes hold the way', '3 hp short'), with ranked patches ('hp < 20% → return · survives 100% · base 8%'); lapse: the applied patch went in at R1, above drink heal, which made the next forecast worse (bank 8%) until I moved it.
I set my own goals (frontier vs gold, bank depth 5/6/8/10, which cage item to take), but the only route choice is how deep, and cages decide for you if you don't tap in time.

Marks came steadily (◆+2..+8 per frontier) and bought rows, cards and automations ('auto: restock', 'auto: keep weapon+armour'); lapse: gold reached $2016 with almost nothing to buy, and several unlocks sat behind '⊘ slay a boss' / '⊘ an egg'.
Painted camp banner, parchment report plaques and a torn red death banner with a 'GAP' seal look good; the dungeon tiles were the same brown blocks for eight floors.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: The return report ('PLATEAU — R3 return ended 13 runs, none past D8', 'R2 fired 0 of 16 runs') led directly to two edits and a purchase that broke the boss within 15 minutes; lapse: the overnight's 16 runs had 0 deaths and all read alike (13 'returned $31-55'), so there was little to read beyond the audit.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Callouts carry the row number ('R2 · retreat', 'R6 · card gas') and the reel credits rows ('R7 attack saved him.'), so I said 'my rule' about wins and my deaths; lapse: bought cards fire as 'card thief guard' blocks whose inner lines I didn't write, and a monkey stole the sword despite that card with no row blamed.
